envDependencies.SAP_BASE_URL: Read from .env — used as the base URL in navigation steps

envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — password for SAP Fiori login

TD-MM-PR-CREATE-001.name: Create Purchase Requisition — Primary Happy Path
TD-MM-PR-CREATE-001.expectedOutcome: Purchase requisition created; message 'Purchase requisition number {PR_NUMBER} created' displayed at the bottom of the screen

TD-MM-PR-CHANGE-001.name: Change Purchase Requisition — Update Quantity
TD-MM-PR-CHANGE-001.expectedOutcome: PR quantity updated; message 'Purchase requisition number {{EXISTING_PR_NUMBER}} changed' displayed at the bottom of the screen

TD-MM-PR-DISPLAY-001.name: Display Purchase Requisition — Read-only View
TD-MM-PR-DISPLAY-001.expectedOutcome: Purchase requisition displayed in read-only mode; header details and item details visible
